ideas.pitch: A multi-agent system that autonomously monitors UEM Jaipur campus maintenance tickets, cross-references hardware inventories, and dispatches service personnel using local LLM workflows.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Facilities Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 'Agentic Harness' track by using autonomous decision-making to solve a real-world problem faced directly by university organizers and students on campus.

ideas.pitch: An agentic interview simulator that analyzes a student's resume, scrapes active job descriptions, and executes a multi-turn dynamic technical mock interview with autonomous evaluation loops.
ideas.title: UEM Placement Prep Autonomous Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem judges and students care deeply about—placements at UEM Jaipur—while fully leveraging the 'Agentic Harness' track's focus on autonomous workflows.

ideas.pitch: An open innovation platform that aggregates utility consumption data across university buildings to forecast energy spikes using Poisson regression models and suggest reduction strategies.
ideas.title: EcoCampus Carbon Footprint Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins through clear measurable environmental impact and advanced data modeling, adapting robust statistical forecasting seen in top competition wins.

ideas.pitch: An agentic workflow tool that resolves scheduling conflicts for specialized UEM laboratory equipment, auto-negotiating time slots and notifying students via automated event loops.
ideas.title: Autonomous Lab Equipment Booking Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the 'Agentic Harness' track by removing friction from campus life using multi-agent negotiation rather than static database locks.

ideas.pitch: A software solution connecting local Jaipur artisans directly with student cooperatives, matching inventory supply with bulk campus demand through predictive demand forecasting.
ideas.title: Local Artisan Supply Chain Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the 'Open Innovation' track with a concrete economic benefit and clear regional relevance to Rajasthan's artisan economy.
